children: Íslandsbanki will offer ISK-denominated covered bonds in the series ISB CB 31 and ISB CBI 32 on Thursday 12 November 2026.
The bonds will be offered in a single-price auction, where all accepted offers will be awarded at the highest accepted yield.
Íslandsbanki reserves the right to accept or reject offers in part or in whole.
The covered bonds have been issued under the Bank’s covered bond programme. The Base Prospectus is available here: Covered bonds programme.
The auction will be managed by Íslandsbanki’s Fixed Income Sales. Offers shall be submitted by e-mail to vbm@isb.is before 16:00 p.m. on 12 November 2026.
